Date August 6 31/1931

Subject (in full) Seizure of Japanese goods by anti-Japanese Association.

Made by J. D. S. Umemoto Forwarded by

Enquiries made in connection with the attached translation
from the Shanghai Nippo, dated July 30, 1931, regarding the
seizure of Japanese goods by the Anti-Japanese Association
show that at 2 p.m. July 29, '31, a number of Anti-Japanese boycott
pickets proceeded by boat along the Whangpoo River and boarded a
tender at the Peking Road Jetty, on which was loaded 55 bales of
cotton yarn valued at $12,350.00, the property of the Nippon
Menka (Japan Cotton Trading Co., 8 Hankow Road). The pickets then
ordered the laocah to proceed to Lok Ka Doo, Pootung, where he
was given a receipt for the goods seized.

At 3.30 p.m. July 29, '31, another party of Anti-Japanese
boycott pickets boarded from the river a tender, which was lying
alongside the Hunt's Wharf, and seized 163 bales of cotton yarn
valued at $39,140.00, belonging to the same company. These
goods were also taken to the Loh Ka Doo Wharf, Pootung, where a
receipt for them was given. On this occasion the actual tender
was towed away by a launch to the Loh Ka Doo Wharf.

On learning of these incidents, the owner reported the matter
to the Japanese Consulate and in company with a Consular represen-
tative proceeded to the Headquarters of the Anti-Japanese
Association to lodge a protest against the seizure and succeeded
in effecting the release of the goods seized together with 20
bales of cotton yarn, valued at $5,200.00, which were seized
on July 24, 1931, while being transported from the H.K.K. Pootung
Wharf to the Peking Road Jetty. However, the company was obliged
to pay $350.00 as storage before the goods were released from the
Loh Ka Doo Wharf.

Attached are photographic copies of the receipt issued by
the pickets.

主题（全称） 反日协会扣押日货。

制作人 J. D. S. Umemoto 转呈人

就随附的1931年7月30日《上海日报》（Shanghai Nippo）译文所进行的查询，该报道涉及反日协会扣押日货一事，查询结果显示：1931年7月29日下午2时，多名反日抵制纠察队员乘船沿黄浦江行进，并在北京路码头登上一艘驳船，船上装载有55包棉纱，价值12,350.00美元，系日本棉花公司（Nippon Menka，即日本棉花贸易公司，地址：汉口路8号）之财产。随后，纠察队员命令船老大（laocah）驶往浦东陆家嘴（Lok Ka Doo），并就该批被扣货物向其出具了收据。

1931年7月29日下午3时30分，另一伙反日抵制纠察队员从水上登上一艘停靠在亨特码头（Hunt's Wharf）旁的驳船，扣押了属于同一家公司的163包棉纱，价值39,140.00美元。这批货物也被运至浦东陆家嘴码头（Loh Ka Doo Wharf），并就此出具了收据。此次，该驳船实际由一艘汽艇拖曳至陆家嘴码头。

获悉这些事件后，货主向日本领事馆报告此事，并与一名领事馆代表一同前往反日协会总部，就扣押行为提出抗议，成功促使被扣货物获释，其中包括于1931年7月24日在从日清汽船会社（H.K.K.）浦东码头运往北京路码头途中被扣押的20包棉纱，价值5,200.00美元。然而，在货物从陆家嘴码头放行之前，该公司被迫支付350.00美元作为仓储费。

附件为纠察队出具的收据的照片副本。

July 30, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

ANTI JAPANESE ASSOCIATION SEIZES JAPANESE GOODS IN
THE INTERNATIONAL SETTLEMENT

The Shanghai Nippo publishes
the following report:-
It is reported that yesterday
in broad day light two seizures of Japanese goods
were effected by the Anti-Japanese Association in
the International Settlement after the Shanghai
Municipal Council had issued strict instructions
prohibiting the seizure of Japanese goods by the
Anti-Japanese Association in the Settlement. The
Anti-Japanese boycott pickets are conducting themselves
like robbers and are thus demonstrating that they
lack the qualification of being citizens of a civilized
country.
At 3 p.m. yesterday several
Chinese who appeared to be the so-called inspectors
of the Anti-Japanese Association boarded a tender
at the Peking Road jetty, on which were loaded 65
bags of Japanese cotton thread valued at $15,000.00
and belonging to the Nippon Kenka. They ordered the
tender to proceed to Pootung.
At 3.50 p.m. yesterday the
anti-Japanese boycott pickets also seized 140 bags
of Japanese cotton thread valued at $28,000.00 and
belonging to the Nippon Menka. The goods which were
on the Wangtszepoo House Jetty were taken away in
motor trucks.
These seizures have been duly reported
to the Japanese Consulate.

The above seized goods were immediately
restored to their owner.

Acting on an urgent request
from the owner of the above seized goods, the Japanese
authorities accompanied by the owner proceeded to
the Anti-Japanese Association's headquarters and
opened negotiations there which effected the immediate
release of the seized goods to the owner.
Shanghai citizens received a great
shock on learning of the above seizure as it was
perpetrated immediately after Mr. Fessenden, Commissioner-
General of the Shanghai Municipal Council had issued
the notification strictly prohibiting the seizure of
Japanese goods in the Settlement.

1931年7月30日。下午译文。

杂项

反日协会在公共租界内扣押日货

《上海日报》刊登如下报道：
据报道，昨日光天化日之下，反日协会在公共租界内实施了两次对日货的扣押行动，此举发生在上海公共租界工部局发布严禁反日协会在租界内扣押日货的严令之后。反日抵制纠察队的行为如同强盗，从而表明他们缺乏作为文明国家公民的资格。
昨日下午3时，几名自称是反日协会所谓检查员的中国人登上停泊在北京路码头的一艘驳船，船上装载有属于日本棉花公司（Nippon Kenka）的65袋日本棉线，价值15,000.00美元。他们命令该驳船驶往浦东。
昨日下午3时50分，反日抵制纠察队还扣押了属于日本棉花公司（Nippon Menka）的140袋日本棉线，价值28,000.00美元。停在王家宅码头（Wangtszepoo House Jetty）的货物被用汽车运走。
上述扣押事件已正式报告给日本领事馆。

上述被扣货物已立即归还原主。

应上述被扣货物货主的紧急请求，日本当局在货主陪同下前往反日协会总部，并在那里展开谈判，促使被扣货物立即释放给货主。
上海市民得知上述扣押事件后大为震惊，因为此事发生在上海公共租界工部局总办费森登（Fessenden）先生发布严禁在租界内扣押日货的通知之后不久。
